description: This Java interface defines the CustomApiRoutesProvider, which provides methods for supplying custom routes for unauthorized and authorized access within an API gateway service in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CustomApiRoutesProvider
classes.description: An interface for providing custom API route handlers for authorized and unauthorized access.

methods.name: unauthorized
methods.description: Returns a custom route for handling unauthorized access, given the API version and correlation ID.

methods.name: authorized
methods.description: Returns a custom route for handling authorized access, given the request headers.
